SELECT * FROM ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT L.LOST_ID AS ID, 'lost' AS ITEM_TYPE, L.TITLE, L.ITEM_NAME, L.STATUS, CASE WHEN L.STATUS IN ('RETURNED', 'COMPLETED') THEN '반환완료' ELSE '접수중' END AS STATUS_NAME, LOC.LOCATION_NAME, L.LOST_LOCATION_DETAIL AS LOCATION_DETAIL, L.LOST_DATE AS ITEM_DATE, L.LOST_TIME AS ITEM_TIME, L.VIEW_COUNT, LOC.LATITUDE, LOC.LONGITUDE, '/lost/detail/' || L.LOST_ID AS DETAIL_URL, L.CREATED_AT FROM LOST_ITEMS L LEFT JOIN LOCATIONS LOC ON LOC.LOCATION_ID = L.LOST_LOCATION_ID
AND L.STATUS != 'DELETED'
AND 1 = 1
AND L.STATUS NOT IN ('RETURNED', 'COMPLETED')
AND L.STATUS IN ('RETURNED', 'COMPLETED')
AND 1 = 0
AND ( L.TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR L.ITEM_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR L.LOST_LOCATION_DETAIL LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR LOC.LOCATION_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
UNION ALL
SELECT F.FOUND_ID AS ID, 'found' AS ITEM_TYPE, F.TITLE, F.ITEM_NAME, F.STATUS, CASE WHEN F.STATUS IN ('RETURNED', 'COMPLETED') THEN '반환완료' ELSE '보관중' END AS STATUS_NAME, LOC.LOCATION_NAME, F.FOUND_LOCATION_DETAIL AS LOCATION_DETAIL, F.FOUND_DATE AS ITEM_DATE, F.FOUND_TIME AS ITEM_TIME, F.VIEW_COUNT, LOC.LATITUDE, LOC.LONGITUDE, '/found/detail/' || F.FOUND_ID AS DETAIL_URL, F.CREATED_AT FROM FOUND_ITEMS F LEFT JOIN LOCATIONS LOC ON LOC.LOCATION_ID = F.FOUND_LOCATION_ID
AND F.STATUS != 'DELETED'
AND F.STATUS NOT IN ('RETURNED', 'COMPLETED')
AND F.STATUS IN ('RETURNED', 'COMPLETED')
AND 1 = 0
AND ( F.TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR F.ITEM_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR F.FOUND_LOCATION_DETAIL LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR LOC.LOCATION_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
) ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 100
